description: What is OpenAI Dots? OpenAI just dropped Dots, always-on AI agents inside ChatGPT that can work for you 24/7, even when you’re offline. In this video, we break down what OpenAI Dots are, how they differ from normal ChatGPT, how they use their own cloud browser to work across apps like Slack, Email, and GitHub, and what proactive research and approvals mean for your workflow. We also look at how Dots shift AI from one-time prompts to ongoing work that can continue in the background. Would you trust an AI agent to handle your work emails?
